## Type

- [ ] New entry

## Checklist

- [ ] Entry follows the format: `- [Name](url) — One factual sentence ending in period.`
- [ ] Entry is alphabetized within its section.
- [ ] No editorial superlatives ("best", "amazing", "must-have").
- [ ] No public pricing or customer logos.
- [ ] URL is on a canonical / well-known domain.
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes locally.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under [Unreleased].
